description: Hard-degradation taxonomy for judge calibration (Metis B3). Proves the judge catches the corruptions we knew how to inject, not the real error distribution. Each axis maps error type -> injection method -> detection criterion, with an independent chance baseline and acceptance floor. An axis gates C3 layer 4 ONLY if its calibrated detection-rate CI lower bound exceeds its chance baseline; axes that fail are marked no-gate. No aggregate AUC may hide a failed axis.

primary.architecture: DeepSeek-V3 (MoE, same family as generation judge stack)
primary.role: primary judge for C3 layer-4 gating

secondary.architecture: Anthropic Claude (dense decoder-only transformer, RLHF lineage distinct from DeepSeek)
secondary.role: architecturally-unrelated second judge (Metis B4: generator and primary judge share the DeepSeek family -> require an unrelated second judge or explicitly acknowledge self-consistency)
secondary.unrelated_architecture_reason: DeepSeek-V3 is a MoE trained with open-data RLVR; Claude is a proprietary dense model trained with Constitutional AI/RLHF from a different lab. Correlated failure modes on Vietnamese tone/orientation are far less likely than between two DeepSeek-family models. Provisioning deferred: no API key in this environment (W0.6 caveat path applies until provisioned).

degradation.description: Replace a Vietnamese word with a valid same-word different-tone word (ma -> ma, ban -> ban) at a fixed rate

tone.detection_criterion: Judge flags the reading if any detected word's tone is inconsistent with its context (valid word, wrong tone)
tone.chance_baseline_rationale: Six-tone substitution: a random guess among the 6 tones is correct with p=1/6

degradation.description: Take the upright meaning and negate it with a particle while preserving the reversed keyword atoms, so the text reads as reversed without the reversed card semantics

orientation.detection_criterion: Judge flags the reading if the text claims a reversed orientation but its semantics match the upright meaning negated (orientation collapse)

degradation.description: Rewrite a Vietnamese clause in English word order while keeping the correct Vietnamese function-word distribution (function words preserved, syntax calqued)

translationese.detection_criterion: Judge flags the reading if the clause order follows English rather than Vietnamese discourse structure despite correct function words

degradation.description: Keep the correct card name but draw the meaning from an adjacent card of the same suit
degradation.adjacency: same-suit neighbour (e.g. Knight of Cups meaning swapped onto Page of Cups)

faithfulness.detection_criterion: Judge flags the reading if the stated meaning belongs to a different card than the named card
faithfulness.chance_baseline_rationale: One correct card vs 7 adjacent same-suit candidates: random pick is correct with p=1/8

calibration.reproducibility: fixed seed; both judges score the identical degraded corpus; per-axis rates reported independently
